China reviews reliance on foreign AI hardware

China is reviewing its dependence on foreign companies for data center switches, particularly those used in artificial intelligence infrastructure. This review is part of a broader effort to promote domestic technology firms and reduce reliance on foreign AI hardware. The move aims to foster self-sufficiency in the critical AI sector.
